paired_sampling.official_seed_semantics: The released script calls torch.manual_seed(0) separately for every prompt, so all arms preserve that exact behavior.

comparison_contract: Only sg_scale differs between the two primary arms; CFG, PAG, scheduler, prompts, prompt order, seed semantics, model, precision and image size are identical.

evaluation.primary: The released repository's 5000-image COCO FID against T2IBenchmark packaged COCO reference statistics.
evaluation.scope_warning: Report as COCO-5K FID; do not compare directly with 30K or 50K generated-sample FID.
evaluation.smoke_gate: Both arms must complete all 8 prompts; baseline rerun must be pixel-identical; outputs must have identical dimensions and no missing indices before the 5K run.

method_boundary: This first stage reproduces the released Self-Guidance implementation. It does not yet add cross-scale path evidence or any new intervention.
